senses.gloss: f. (preced. wds.) retribution, reward; esp. punishment, divine visitation; evil dispensation, reverses.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 76a:7">Yoma 76ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 100b:1">Snh. 100ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>מידה טובה מרובה ממידת פ׳</he> the measure of divine goodness is larger than that of evil dispensation.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 102a:4">Ib. 102ᵃ</cite> <he>עת היא מזומנת לפ׳</he> (not <he>מזומן</he>) there is a time designated for visitation (of man’s sins); <he>מקום … לפ׳</he> there is a place designated for &c.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:7">Ab. I, 7</cite>, v. <cite ref="J00023"><he>יָאַשׁ</he></cite>; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 14b:11">B. Bath. 14ᵇ</cite>, v. next w.—Pl. <he>פּוּרְעָנִיּוֹת</he>.
Ab. V, 8 שבעה מיני פ׳ וכ׳ (some ed. sing.) seven kinds of visitations come upon the world.
<cite ref="Taanit 14a:11">Taan. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>ושאר כל מיני פ׳ וכ׳</he> and all other calamities that threaten &c.; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 80b:11">B. Kam. 80ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 18b:8">R. Hash. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>אני מונה לסדר פ׳</he> I count (the fast-days) according to the chronological order of the sad events (which they commemorate); a. fr.
